The app requests MathML output for native browser rendering and accessibility. It does not need KaTeX CSS or font downloads. The renderer is cached with the offline app shell. Supported delimiters: `$…$`, `$$…$$`, `\(…\)`, and `\[…\]`; code spans and fenced code stay literal. Unsafe TeX commands are disabled.
